scope: Eight bounded source/project/catalog pages inspected through public retrieval; not an image-web census, not per-asset downloading, not exhaustive prior-chat recovery.
source_of_truth: Official item/project/catalog URLs with per-item rights state; third-party search thumbnails are not licenses.
priority_rule: rank by expected practical value, novelty, cross-surface reuse and falsifiability, with costs and license friction; score is advisory not evidence or permission

candidate_assets.name: Network-Graph.svg
candidate_assets.creator: Graphpedia
candidate_assets.hypothesis: Minimal machine-readable node-edge glyph twin can improve compact CoGlyph/CoMap navigation versus text list.
candidate_assets.test: Compare deterministic graph->text->graph identity and readable keyboard navigation against text-only baseline.

candidate_assets.name: NetworkGraph.png
candidate_assets.creator: Logan Essex
candidate_assets.hypothesis: Color-coded highlighted hubs/paths may support richer visual hierarchy while preserving all graph nodes through a text counterpart.
candidate_assets.test: Assess comprehension and color-blind text-twin parity; check attribution, change notes and ShareAlike before publishing derivative.

candidate_assets.name: Ring Current in Earth's Magnetosphere
candidate_assets.creator: NASA SVS
candidate_assets.hypothesis: Time-varying field-line and torus visualization suggests observer-relative CoTime+ controls, but simulation imagery is not measured CoAll physics.
candidate_assets.test: Compare annotated time scrubber, provenance and simulation-vs-observation labels against a static diagram.

candidate_assets.name: Triceratops horridus Marsh, 1889
candidate_assets.creator: Smithsonian National Museum of Natural History
candidate_assets.hypothesis: Rotatable provenance-bound 3D model can teach CoOrb spatial layers and CoSubstrate alternatives.
candidate_assets.test: Measure 2D vs 3D vs accessible text understanding, device cost, frame rate and reduced-motion fallback.

candidate_assets.name: Spring Open Movie
candidate_assets.creator: Blender Animation Studio
candidate_assets.hypothesis: Original shots, storyboards, rigs and animations can inspire versioned CoMediaLineage and CoCoherence render/provenance flows.
candidate_assets.test: Trace one storyboard-to-shot-to-render lineage with attribution and separate soundtrack/logo exclusions.

candidate_assets.name: Openverse open-media discovery API
candidate_assets.creator: Openverse contributors
candidate_assets.hypothesis: Rate-limited catalog searches may supply diverse media candidates while retaining original author/license/page evidence.
candidate_assets.test: For one query, compare recall and rights-verification failure rate against a curated human baseline; follow terms and quotas.

candidate_assets.name: Observable D3 Gallery
candidate_assets.creator: D3 / Observable example authors
candidate_assets.hypothesis: Treemap, graph, motion and alternate-scale visual idioms are candidates for CoOrbWare progressive disclosure and CoMap comparisons.
candidate_assets.test: Use original independent implementation, first-use comprehension and keyboard access test; license individual donor before copying code or data.

candidate_assets.name: Linked Commons graph interface
candidate_assets.creator: Creative Commons project contributors
candidate_assets.hypothesis: License-aware network navigation can join discoverable media sources by type and author without global asset replication.
candidate_assets.test: Compare source-to-license path clarity and precision against plain URL table; inspect source/software/artwork license separately.

fanin_rule: Deduplicate by canonical item URL + source identity, check independent source rights, elect at most three research-only previews, retain contradictions and HELD.
